overview: The Medford School Committee recognized Science Fair winners and updated the vocational program's admissions policy. The committee also discussed potential revisions to the 2026-2027 school calendar and began a formal review of its operating rules.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine bills, payroll, a $1,000 donation from the PTO, and the meeting minutes from April 6, 2026.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Science Fair Awardees
items.summary: Director of Science Rocco Cieri and student winners presented award-winning projects from the annual Medford High School Science Fair, covering topics ranging from sandstorm electricity generation to violin tone analysis.

items.title: CTE Program Admissions Policy Update
items.summary: Approved updates to the Chapter 74 Vocational-Technical Education admissions policy to incorporate state feedback regarding lottery procedures and student retention pathways.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2026-2027 Calendar Review
items.summary: The committee discussed revising the previously approved 2026-2027 calendar due to staffing shortages on religious holidays and a late Labor Day start. Superintendent Galusi and the committee explored options such as earlier start dates or swapping professional development days and will seek union and community feedback before presenting a formal proposal.

items.title: Review of Summary of Objectives
items.summary: Tabled the review of the committee's summary of objectives from its January retreat.

items.title: School Committee Rules and Revisions
items.summary: The committee conducted a section-by-section review of its operating rules, proposing updates to summer meeting requirements, subcommittee procedures, and packet delivery timelines. A consolidated version of the revisions will be presented for a final vote at the next meeting.
